question: In which month, as per the Hindu calendar, is the birth anniversary of Lord Mahavir Swami celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is **Chaitra**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Mahavir Swami** was the 24th Tirthankara of Jainism.
 
• His birth anniversary is celebrated as **Mahavir Jayanti**.
 
• According to the Hindu calendar, Mahavir Jayanti falls in the month of **Chaitra**.
 
• This festival is observed on the 13th day of the bright half of the month of Chaitra.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Chaitra: The month in which Mahavir Jayanti is celebrated.
 
 

 Option 2
 Kartik: Known for Diwali and other festivals but not Mahavir Jayanti.
 
 

 Option 3
 Magha: Associated with Makar Sankranti and other festivals.
 
 

 Option 4
 Vaisakha: Known for Buddha Purnima and other events.
